info.title: Bannerbear Universal API
info.description: Create, manage, and automate image and video generation

post.description: Creates a new collection in Bannerbear.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

template_set.description: The template set uid that you want to use.

modifications[].description: A list of modifications you want to make.

modifications[].name.description: The name of the layer you want to change.

modifications[].text.description: Replacement text you want to use.

modifications[].color.description: Color in hex format, for example #FF0000.

modifications[].background.description: Background color in hex format, for example #FF0000.

webhook_url.description: A URL to POST the full Collection object to upon rendering completion.

metadata.description: Any metadata that you need to store, for example a record ID.

transparent.description: Render the collection with a transparent background.

post.description: Creates a new image in Bannerbear.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

modifications.description: Layer modifications to apply when generating the image.

webhookUrl.description: Webhook URL to receive the render result.

transparent.description: Render the image with a transparent background when supported.

renderPdf.description: Render a PDF instead of an image when supported.

templateVersion.description: Specific template version number to render.

metadata.description: Custom metadata to attach to the generated image.

post.description: Creates a new movie in Bannerbear.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

width.description: The desired width of your movie.

height.description: The desired height of your movie.

inputs[].description: A list of videos or images you want to combine into a movie.

inputs[].asset_url.description: URL to a video file or static image.

inputs[].trim_to_length_in_seconds.description: Force trim the end video to a specific time.

inputs[].mute.description: Remove the sound from this video clip.

inputs[].soundtrack_url.description: URL to an audio file to overlay on top of this clip.

transition.description: The name of the transition to use between video clips.

soundtrack_url.description: URL to an audio file to overlay on top of the movie.

webhook_url.description: A URL to POST the full Movie object to upon rendering completion.

metadata.description: Any metadata that you need to store, for example a record ID.

post.description: Creates a new video in Bannerbear.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

modifications.description: Layer modifications to apply when generating the video.

zoom.description: Zoom mode for the generated video.

zoomFactor.description: Zoom factor for the generated video.

blur.description: Blur amount for the generated video.

trimStartTime.description: Start time for trimming the input media.

trimEndTime.description: End time for trimming the input media.

trimToLengthInSeconds.description: Trim the input media to a target duration in seconds.

webhookUrl.description: Webhook URL to receive the render result.

metadata.description: Custom metadata to attach to the generated video.

frames.description: Per-frame layer data for animated scenes when supported.

frameDurations.description: Frame durations for animated video scenes.

createGifPreview.description: Create a GIF preview for the generated video.
